name: Mille-Feuille
description: Crispy puff pastry layers alternating with vanilla pastry cream and topped with fondant icing piped in a feather pattern.
ingredients: a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with unsalted butter.
In a large bowl, whisk together the arborio rice and fresh thyme until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the cognac with the chicken stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 25 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with parsley or a dusting of crème fraîche.
tips: Bring your cognac to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
